rationale: The counter-proof that makes R1 load-bearing: a json.dumps(sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=True) serialization of the SAME object must produce a DIFFERENT content root. If the two agreed, R1 would be an empty requirement. The divergence is string escaping alone — \uXXXX against raw UTF-8 — which is why three ASCII-only vectors did not isolate it.
